sentences.text: By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.7301 of 2022 at Police Station-Seorahi, District-Kushi Nagar under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 01.11.2022.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 10.02.2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The following arguments made by Shri Safiullah, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record,
entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The delay in lodgment of the F.I.R. in the facts of the case is fatal to the prosecution case.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: 2. The applicant and the victim were intimate.

2. The present application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 195 of 2023
(Session Trial No. 386 of 2025), under Sections 504, 506, 376 I.P.C., Police Station Kishanpur,
District Fatehpur, with the prayer that in the event of arrest, applicant may be released on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 4 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: 3.  Learned counsel for the applicant argued that this is the second anticipatory bail application moved on behalf of applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 4 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: His first anticipatory bail was dismissed on merits vide order dated 14.08.2025 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 9433 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 9433 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 4 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: Earlier, in the first anticipatory bail application a coordinate Bench of this Court vide order 24.09.2024 granted interim anticipatory bail to the applicant till the next date of listing, in compliance of such order the applicant before the concerned court and since then he is appearing regularly before the concerned trial court and he has not misused the interim anticipatory bail granted to him.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 4 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: It has also been submitted that applicant has no criminal antecedents and the applicant undertakes to cooperate during the trial and he would appear as and when required by the concerned trial court.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 4 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: It has been stated that in case, the applicant is granted anticipatory bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate with the investigation and would obey all conditions of bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 4 November, 2025.json

sentences.text:
4. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the application for anticipatory bail by contending that the victim has adduced her evidence at the trial by making specific allegation of rape against the applicant, thus, applicant does not deserve any indulgence and the present second anticipatory bail application may be dismissed.
5.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 4 November, 2025.json

sentences.text:
From perusal of record it transpires that the victim (P.W.1) at the trial has made specific allegation of rape against the applicant as she alleged in her statements recorded under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., thus, she has supported the prosecution case at the trial.
6.
sentences._hearing_file: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 4 November, 2025.json

sentences.text: In the case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by Hon'ble Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.
